title: DistroKid Stream Spike After Pitching
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:distribution pitch_channel=* stream_lift_pct=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(stream_lift_pct) as metric by _time pitch_channel
| sort 0 _time pitch_channel
description: Trends monthly stream lift percentage by pitch channel for release campaigns.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether release campaigns are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `pitch_channel` on `music:distribution` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly stream lift percentage.
visualization: Line chart of monthly stream lift percentage by pitch channel.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how stream lift percentage changes month by month for each pitch channel so you can see whether release campaigns are heading the right way.
